proposal: The Mandate recommends transferring the Maritime Administration, including the U.S. Merchant Marine Academy, out of DOT to the Department of Homeland Security, or to the Department of Defense if the Coast Guard is located there. It argues this would align MARAD with the Coast Guard and ease Jones Act waiver processing and use of the Ready Reserve Force.

status_summary: No proposal, order or bill to move MARAD out of DOT was found. A Congressional Research Service report dated 2025-08-27 says all of MARAD's powers are vested by statute in the Secretary of Transportation, says the administration had announced no specific DOT reorganization plan, and does not describe any proposal to move MARAD.
title: Transfer MARAD and the Merchant Marine Academy to DHS or DoD
uncertainties: No proposal, order or bill to move MARAD or the Merchant Marine Academy out of DOT was found. The CRS report of 2025-08-27 says MARAD's powers are vested by statute in the Secretary of Transportation, and Executive Order 14269 assigns maritime tasks to DOT. About 100,000 of 144,000 characters of the S. 1541 text were read, so its Academy section was not reviewed. The Unified Agenda rule lists on reginfo.gov for DOT and DHS (both headed 'Agency Rule List - 2026') show 11 MARAD rulemakings issued under DOT, including an Academy service obligation rule, and none on a transfer; a transfer would need legislation, so the agenda is a weak test. Checked systematically on 2026-10-19.
